feeding_claim.verbatim: The Bur-Ger Farm (in Benson, Vermont) sells 100% grass fed beef, pasture-raised pork and pasture-raised lamb to New England areas along with farm-fresh chicken (VT only).

pickup_locations: Otter Creek Fun Park, Danby, VT
Smokey House Center Farmstand, Danby, VT

notes: On-farm sales Tuesday to Friday, call ahead. Delivery to the Rutland and Middlebury areas with a $100 minimum and 48 hours notice; site gives conflicting delivery days. Says it sells to New England areas but names no shipping. Category cautious grass-fed: 100% grass fed, finishing unstated.
